sms_code_invalid: SMS verification code is wrong or has expired
credentials_changed: Password changed or user disabled during sign-in: no session started
bind_refused: Account verified, but WeChat account linking was refused or canceled in the meantime (that WeChat account or this user is already linked, the credentials changed, or the account was unlinked): no session started
locked: Too many failed attempts: this username is locked on this IP for {minutes} minutes
ip_blocked: IP address is on the sign-in blacklist
captcha_required: Captcha ticket missing, invalid or expired
refresh_reuse: Refresh token replayed: the session was revoked
lock_screen_exceeded: Too many wrong lock-screen passwords: the session was revoked
password_check_exceeded: Too many wrong current-password checks: all sessions were revoked
